then.text: I'll hold the cover for the ship. It's nice to see a quest completed on time. Have a stamp. No charge.
The cover's in the bag, and so is the stamp. Rua is at the bay, I think he's waiting.
From the Elder? Good. Pitcairn stamps have been our own since 1940, and the postmark is half the price.
Here's a first-day cover, for the ship. Take it to Rua at Bounty Bay. He'll want to know you're serious.

else.text: Stamps, postcards, and a great deal of waiting for the ship. Stamps are what bring collectors, and income, from all over the world. You can send a card from here, if you like.
